candidate_selection.method: Broad reports/ FAIL-verdict scan, staleness-checked by rebuild-first before treating as a real candidate.
candidate_selection.finding: OUTPUT_LOCATION_AUDIT_REPORT was current (not stale) -- 6 image-app native-import files (titanic/spirited_away x v2/v3/v4) sat directly under exports/movie_spatial/ root instead of ACTIVE/TEST/MANUAL/ARCHIVE.

root_cause.method: Static source trace (grep + read) of the 3 writer services and the audit's own scanner.
root_cause.finding: movieScenarioHardening.ts (v2), movieCharacterDNALock.ts (v3), movieTimeSettingLock.ts (v4) each hardcoded output_path directly under exports/movie_spatial/ root. Simultaneously, outputLocationAudit.ts::scanBuilderViolations()'s IMAGE_APP_BUILDER_FILES allowlist -- the mechanism specifically built to catch this class of violation -- did not include any of these 3 files, so the static scan could never have caught it.

policy_precedent.method: Compared with v5/v6/v7 (movieImageAppNativeImportBuilder.ts), the next stages in the same v2->v8 pipeline.
policy_precedent.finding: v5/v6/v7 already write to legacy/exports/movie_spatial/ (an already-ALLOWED_BUILDER_OUTPUT_PATTERNS location), establishing the correct precedent for v2/v3/v4 rather than ACTIVE (reserved for v8 only) or TEST/MANUAL/ARCHIVE (semantically wrong).

downstream_consumer_trace.method: Repo-wide grep for the 6 exact filenames across services/ and scripts/.
downstream_consumer_trace.finding: v2.json and v3.json are never re-read from disk anywhere (only their generator functions are reused in-memory). v4.json IS re-read, via loadMovieImageAppNativeImportV4Dataset() in movieTimeSettingLock.ts itself (self-consistent with the builder's own output_path array). One separate, independently-hardcoded duplicate reference found: movieMasterImportAudit.ts::MASTER_IMPORT_V4_PATH, used only as a report label/error-message string (not a functional file read), which would go stale if not updated alongside the relocation.

relocation_collision_check.method: Before treating the path fix as low-risk, checked whether the precedented target (legacy/exports/movie_spatial/) already held content under the same 6 filenames.
relocation_collision_check.finding: All 6 target filenames already existed there, dated 2026-06-12 (an untracked, never-committed, ~3-month-old snapshot from the same deterministic builder, structurally identical schema/phase/system_id to the current output, differing only in content because upstream source data had since changed). Zero git history, zero functional reads anywhere (services/scripts/project_brain/project_memory all checked), zero references beyond generic whole-repo file-inventory scanners -- judged stale orphan, safe to overwrite. This check was necessary because a naive path-only fix would have silently destroyed this snapshot on the next build.

v4_blocking_dependency_chain.method: Live rebuild attempts after the wiring fix, root-caused each crash via stack trace + static source trace rather than working around it.
v4_blocking_dependency_chain.finding_1: buildNativeImportV4Slot() crashed reading datasets/generation_context/artstyle/canonical-artstyle.txt (missing). Traced: v2/v3 already use a different, live, working mechanism (canonicalGonegiArtStyle.ts -> master_style_core/canonical-artstyle.json, phase PHASE-MOVIE-SPATIAL-013A) that v4 never migrated to; v4 alone still called the older generationContextLoader.ts::copyCanonicalArtStyle() (phase PHASE-GENERATION-CONTEXT-001, chronologically earlier). Confirmed via legacy/datasets/generation_context/artstyle/canonical-artstyle.txt: the whole old copy-only generation-context system had been formally archived to a legacy/ mirror, matching the same archival convention as the exports/ case, but v4's one call site was never repointed.
v4_blocking_dependency_chain.finding_2: After fixing artStyle, the very next line crashed identically on copyCanonicalTimeSetting() (3 call sites total, 1 more than initially estimated) reading datasets/generation_context/timesetting/canonical-timesetting-library.json (also missing, also archived to legacy/datasets/generation_context/timesetting/). v2 was independently confirmed to already resolve its own timeSetting field from a different, live, working source (TIME_SETTING_LIBRARY_PATH via scenario-generator-foundation.js). movieTimeSettingLock.ts already contained its own exported, live replacement (buildLockedTimeSettingFieldFromGraph(), already consumed by movieMasterImportAudit.ts for its own independent audit slot construction) -- the same repeated pattern as the artStyle case, confirming it as a proven, reusable diagnostic method rather than a one-off.

builder_path_relocation.change: output_path changed from 'exports/movie_spatial/...' (root) to `${LEGACY_MOVIE_SPATIAL_EXPORT_ROOT}/...` (imported from generationOutputPaths.ts), matching v5/v6/v7's existing precedent exactly.

scanner_coverage_fix.change: Added the 3 builder filenames to IMAGE_APP_BUILDER_FILES so scanBuilderViolations() actually watches them going forward.

stale_label_sync.change: MASTER_IMPORT_V4_PATH synced to the new legacy path so report output no longer names a path the file does not live at.

artstyle_wiring_fix.change: artStyle field production switched from the dead generationContextLoader.ts::copyCanonicalArtStyle() to the live, already-used-elsewhere canonicalGonegiArtStyle.ts::resolveCanonicalGonegiArtStyle(root).value.

timesetting_wiring_fix.change: All 3 copyCanonicalTimeSetting() call sites (field production, evaluateTimeSettingLockChecks's expected value, validateTimeSettingSlot's expected value) switched to the live, already-used-elsewhere buildLockedTimeSettingFieldFromGraph(graph, root).value. The now-unused generationContextLoader.js import was removed.

orphan_cleanup.pre_delete_fresh_check: Immediately before deletion, re-ran a repo-wide grep for the 6 exact root filenames across services/ and scripts/ (zero matches) and re-confirmed the 6 legacy replacements existed with fresh content -- not relying on the earlier turn's assessment alone.

master_import_audit.regression: unchanged before/after root deletion -- confirms zero downstream dependency on the deleted root files

verification.legacy_replacement_confirmed: All 6 legacy/exports/movie_spatial/*-v{2,3,4}.json files confirmed present with 2026-09-03 generated_at (not the prior 2026-06-12 stale content) before the root originals were deleted.

canonical_history_dedup_check.method: retrieveCanonicalHistoryByProblem live against the real canonical corpus for 10 query phrases, plus a repo-wide keyword grep across every project-brain-experience-*.json file's full content (not just the problem field) for output_location/scanBuilderViolations/IMAGE_APP_BUILDER_FILES/legacy-exports/orphan/canonical-artstyle/canonical-timesetting/generationContextLoader.

canonical_history_dedup_check.keyword_grep_result: 1 match (exp_genie_outcome_capture_idempotency_v1), confirmed unrelated (GENIE's own outcome-capture idempotency, not output-location governance)
canonical_history_dedup_check.conclusion: No duplicate anywhere in the canonical corpus for this domain/pattern.
